fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Rushes you along a line to an enemy up to 6 tiles away, where it deals 14 piercing damage and leaves it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Lunge
fusions.desc: Lunges at an enemy up to 8 tiles away and deals 28 piercing damage, rising to double that at 8 tiles. It always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Quarry in Sight
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds, and your movement speed rises by 15% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: On the Trail
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 15% more damage.
